courses.title: Build your first data report
courses.access: Free learning content; optional exams and some software services may cost extra.
courses.outcome: Create a one-page report and explain its limitations.

courses.title: Query a dataset with SQL
courses.access: Free browser exercises; no paid certificate assumed.
courses.outcome: Write SELECT, JOIN and GROUP BY queries on practice data.

courses.title: Python foundations
courses.access: Free documentation. Prior programming concepts help; allow extra practice if new.
courses.outcome: Clean a small CSV with a reproducible script.

courses.title: AI foundations & responsible use
courses.access: Free catalogue; registration may be required. Confirm current course availability.
courses.outcome: Compare an AI answer with primary sources and record its errors.

courses.title: Communicate a technical finding
courses.access: Free course materials; focused on technical writing.
courses.outcome: Write a plain-language brief for a non-specialist audience.

courses.title: Evaluate data and model limits
courses.access: Free lessons; Python and basic maths recommended.
courses.outcome: Identify leakage, bias and missing evidence in a sample analysis.

courses.title: Understand the sustainability goals
courses.access: Free reference material; self-directed study, not an accredited course.
courses.outcome: Write a local project brief tied to one measurable SDG target.

courses.title: Project delivery foundations
courses.access: Free catalogue; registration may be required. Select project management content.
courses.outcome: Create a scoped project plan with risks and milestones.

courses.title: Design for accessibility
courses.access: Free tutorials; some technical examples use HTML.
courses.outcome: Audit a form for labels, keyboard use and readable errors.

courses.title: Digital security foundations
courses.access: Free catalogue; registration may be required. Select cybersecurity content.
courses.outcome: Document a basic threat model and data protection checklist.

sources.title: Malaysia’s transition spans AI, digital and green skills
sources.summary: The workforce impact study examines changing roles and skills across ten sectors. Use it as sector context, not a current vacancy count.
sources.limit: Sector coverage and study assumptions limit generalisation.

sources.title: Task exposure does not establish job loss
sources.summary: A refined occupational index finds potential for tasks to change. Human input remains important in many exposed occupations.
sources.limit: Exposure estimates are not adoption rates or Malaysian forecasts.

sources.title: Digital access shapes who benefits
sources.summary: Research highlights how infrastructure and task differences may produce unequal effects from generative AI.
sources.limit: Global comparisons do not identify local individual outcomes.

sources.title: Exposure is sensitive to tools and task assumptions
sources.summary: A task-based analysis explores possible LLM exposure. It explicitly does not predict a development or adoption timeline.
sources.limit: US context; conceptual exposure must not be read as Malaysian demand.
